title: notes-to-self-2026-03-03
content:
Quick brain dump / TODOs (work + personal) - Mar 3 2026

Work:
- follow up w/ @maya on prefix cache perf numbers (she mentioned 12% win on short seq) - need exact bench commands + env. action: ask for perf table and raw logs.
- PR review: serving-runtime PR #412 - check kv-cache invalidation edge-case (sequence rollover). leave inline comment about unit test for empty-prefix path.
- deploy plan for canary: add rollout steps in doc (canary -> 5% -> 25% -> 100%), add rollback trigger on 95th pctl latency > 200ms. link to confluence page above.
- infra ticket JIRA-4821: patch node pool autoscale config (min=2 -> 3 during peak). confirm with infra before merging.
- quick checklist for demo on Wed:
  * reduced config for demo (single model, 20qps)
  * toggle on verbose logging for trace
  * prepare sample prompts (latency-focused + edge-case prompts)

Personal / errands:
- dentist appt 2026-03-10 10:30am (booked) - need confirm calendar invite to ops channel? maybe not.
- pick up replacement laptop charger (MagSafe) - check spare stash in office before ordering.
- groceries: almond milk, bananas, cold brew concentrate.

Notes to self / random ideas:
- experiment: small LRU cache in front of kv-store for repeated short-prefix queries - might reduce cuda mem thrash. sketch pseudo: hashmap->LRU->ttl, fallback to main prefix cache.
- measure token distribution for internal benchmark set: are >80% queries < 128 tokens? if yes, optimize kernel selection for short sequences.
- prompt set for regression tests: include one deterministic test for date-sensitive outputs (to catch hallucination drift).

Meeting notes (sync 2026-03-03 with SRE):
- incident postmortem in progress for 2026-02-27 outage. next steps: add alert for cache-eviction storm.
- SLO review: propose raising error-budget alert threshold to 0.5% for pipeline 2.

Open questions / followups:
- do we want a shared personal notes folder for eng interns? ask Lila.
- decide on rollout policy for quantized models in dedicated (canary on non-critical traffic first).

Short-term priorities (this week):
1) finish PR #412 + tests
2) get perf table from Maya + update deploy doc
3) autoscale config ticket review

Scratchy TODO (one-liners that I keep forgetting):
- [ ] submit expense for conference travel
- [ ] refill transit card
- [ ] tidy up desk before demo

End of dump. Revisit next day and convert into actionable GH issues where needed.
